links.note: Was on 32963 A Full-Fledged Local Body, the chapter's opening quotation. Inviting a member of a nearby urban local body to class and preparing a set of questions so the meeting is fruitful is verbatim one of the closing questions listed in 32970.

Was on 32965 Decentralised Bodies and Wards. Discussing with adult members of the family and neighbourhood and listing their expectations from the urban local bodies is verbatim one of the closing questions in 32970.
Was on 32963 A Full-Fledged Local Body. Listing the characteristics of a good urban local body is verbatim one of the closing questions in 32970.

Was on 32965 Decentralised Bodies and Wards. The comparison between the Panchayati Raj system and the urban local bodies is 32964's LET'S EXPLORE, asked from the pyramid diagram whose left side was chapter 11 and whose right side is this chapter.

Was on 32966 Functions, and What Citizens Must Do. The term participatory democracy is introduced in 32963 - good governance aims to empower citizens so they may actively participate at every level, and this is the broader concept of participatory democracy.
Was on 32966 Functions, and What Citizens Must Do. Participatory democracy is named in 32963 as the broader concept covering participation at the rural, regional, urban, state and national level.

Was on 32965 Decentralised Bodies and Wards, which covers the wards. The list of functions the answer draws on - infrastructure, burial grounds, garbage collection and disposal, checking government schemes, collecting local taxes and fines - is 32966's.
Was on 32963 A Full-Fledged Local Body. The population rule - only cities above 10 lakhs have a Municipal Corporation, also called Mahanagar Nigam - is stated in 32968.
Was on 32963 A Full-Fledged Local Body. That between 1 and 10 lakhs the highest body is a Municipal Council, also called Nagar Palika, is stated in 32968.
Was on 32963 A Full-Fledged Local Body. That cities and towns with smaller populations have a Nagar Panchayat is stated in 32968.

Was on 32969 What Anita and Sameer Each Correct, which is the community contrast. The electricity wire hanging dangerously low, reported by the children who then asked a Gram Sabha member to shift the electric post, is 32970's story.

Was on 32966 Functions, and What Citizens Must Do. Rustom K. Sidhwa's Constituent Assembly quotation, that people may know what is an administration, what are the franchise, the powers, the rights and the privileges, is in 32963.
Was on 32965 Decentralised Bodies and Wards. The Sidhwa quotation and its argument - that people learn what government is by taking part in the smallest one near them - is 32963's opening.

Was on 32963 A Full-Fledged Local Body. The Madras Corporation's evolution from the East India Company's charter to the Parliamentary Act of 1792 that let it levy taxes is 32967's history, which is where the chapter makes the power to tax the mark of a real local government.

Was on 32963 A Full-Fledged Local Body. The case turns on the body's functions and on citizens acting to make them work, which is 32966 - the list of responsibilities and the insistence that people living in the city must also perform their duties.
Was on 32966 Functions, and What Citizens Must Do. The franchise, powers, rights and privileges the question quotes are from the Sidhwa quotation in 32963.

Was on 32965 Decentralised Bodies and Wards. The wide range of functions the question asks about - infrastructure, burial grounds, garbage, government schemes, local taxes, and planning for economic and social development - is 32966's list.

Was on 32963 A Full-Fledged Local Body. Blocked drains reported by a ward committee, and the committee organising local activity, are 32965's content - ward committees both run things and keep an eye on what goes wrong.
